_metadata.source: Jeppesen Airway Manual - Middle East (p.52-56), North America, and South America

INDIA.name: India ADIZ (Mumbai VABF / Delhi VIDF / Chennai VOMF / Kolkata VECF)

validityWindow.ruleText: ADC is valid from EOBT -15 mins to EOBT +45 mins (EOBT -15m to +3 hrs for domestic non-scheduled). Departure outside this window requires a fresh ADC.

inFlightCheckIn.station: Respective Indian FIC (Mumbai / Delhi / Chennai / Kolkata)
inFlightCheckIn.tolerance: Must obtain/confirm ADC from respective FIC at least 10 minutes prior to entering Indian airspace.

INDIA.exemptions: Local flights within 5 NM radius and <=1000 ft AGL of ARP.
INDIA.interceptionWarning: No flight is permitted without a valid ADC. Deviation from flight plan or operating without ADC subjects the aircraft to IAF identification and interception.

PAKISTAN.name: Pakistan ADIZ (Karachi OPKR / Lahore OPLR)

validityWindow.ruleText: ADC must be obtained before departure. If departure is delayed by more than 60 minutes (>1 hr) at origin or intermediate stop, a NEW ADC must be obtained.

inFlightCheckIn.tolerance: Obtain ADC from respective FIC at least 15 minutes prior to entering Pakistan ADIZ. Must cross established ADIZ entry point within ±5 minutes of estimate.

PAKISTAN.exemptions: Local flights within an Aerodrome Traffic Zone (ATZ).
PAKISTAN.interceptionWarning: Aircraft flying without a valid ADC or deviating >5 mins from entry estimate without notification are liable to PAF interception.

IRAN.name: Iran ADIZ (Tehran FIR OIIX)

validityWindow.ruleText: FIR entry estimates must be made good within ±5 minutes. All aircraft entering Iran ADIZ must be at FL150 or above via published ATS routes.

inFlightCheckIn.station: Iran Air Defense Radar (Tabriz / Babolsar / Mashhad / Birjand / Zabol / Makran / Persian Gulf / Bushehr / Hamadan)
inFlightCheckIn.tolerance: Mandatory radio check-in on 127.8 MHz or 135.1 MHz at least 40 NM prior to entering Tehran FIR (OIIX). Overflight aircraft are forbidden to cross Bushehr VORDME 'BUZ' at FL280 or below.

IRAN.exemptions: Prior permission required if unable to enter at FL150 or above.
IRAN.interceptionWarning: Strict adherence to published ATS routes, FL150+ entry, and 40 NM prior check-in on 127.8 / 135.1 MHz required to prevent interception.

BANGLADESH.name: Bangladesh ADIZ (Dhaka FIR VGFR)

validityWindow.ruleText: ADC valid for entire route. When departure is delayed by more than 2 hours (>120 mins) at departure or intermediate halt, a fresh ADC number MUST be obtained (AFTN: VGHSZQZX / Tel: +880 2 8901081).

inFlightCheckIn.station: Dhaka ATS / Bangladesh Air Force ADU
inFlightCheckIn.tolerance: Obtain ADC at least 10 minutes before entering Bangladesh ADIZ. Off-airway flights must pass ADIZ boundary estimate >=10 mins prior.

BANGLADESH.exemptions: Flights on ATS Routes P646, N895, M770, L524, and W112 are exempt unless deviating toward the landmass of Bangladesh.
BANGLADESH.interceptionWarning: Flying without a valid ADC or deviating toward landmass without clearance subjects aircraft to Bangladesh Air Force interception.

SRI_LANKA.name: Sri Lanka ADIZ (Colombo FIR VCCF)

validityWindow.ruleText: File flight plan >=1 hr prior. Once ADC number is issued, aircraft may depart up to 30 mins prior to EOBT. If delayed >1 hour (>60 mins) from EOBT, a new ADC number must be obtained. Advise Tower >=5 mins prior to startup.

inFlightCheckIn.tolerance: Obtain ADC number and report position/estimate to Colombo ACC at least 15 minutes before penetrating Sri Lanka ADIZ.

SRI_LANKA.exemptions: Local flights within 5 NM radius and <=1000 ft AGL of departure aerodrome.
SRI_LANKA.interceptionWarning: No pilot may deviate from ATC clearance inside Sri Lanka ADIZ; unapproved penetration is subject to Sri Lanka Air Force interception.

CANADA.name: Canada ADIZ (CADIZ — Gander CZQX / Montreal CZUL / Edmonton CZEG / Vancouver CZVR)

validityWindow.ruleText: IFR/DVFR flight plan mandatory. Must revise estimate immediately if penetration time differs by more than ±5 minutes or track differs by >20 NM.

inFlightCheckIn.tolerance: ±5 minutes time tolerance and ±20 NM lateral tolerance from filed CADIZ penetration point.

CANADA.exemptions: Aircraft operating at true airspeed <180 kt when authorized.
CANADA.interceptionWarning: NORAD / RCAF identification and interception procedures apply if penetrating CADIZ outside ±5 min / 20 NM tolerance without ATC notification.

US_ALASKA.name: United States & Alaska Coastal ADIZ (KZWY / KZMA / KZHU / PAZA)

validityWindow.ruleText: 14 CFR Part 99: IFR or DVFR flight plan required. Discrete Mode 3/A + Mode C + 1090ES ADS-B Out and two-way radio required.

inFlightCheckIn.tolerance: ±5 minutes of estimated ADIZ penetration time; ±10 NM (land) / ±20 NM (oceanic) of centerline.

US_ALASKA.interceptionWarning: NORAD / US Air Force & USCG interception on 121.5 MHz if penetrating without discrete squawk or outside ±5 min / 10-20 NM tolerance.

BRAZIL_BORDER.name: Brazil / Paraguay Western Border Air Defense Zone (SBCW / SBAZ / SGFA)

validityWindow.ruleText: International flights crossing the Brazilian border (e.g., SBCW <-> SGFA via FOZ/GUAIRA) require an active IFR Flight Plan, discrete SSR code, and 2-way VHF contact with Curitiba ACC / Asuncion ACC prior to border crossing.

inFlightCheckIn.station: Curitiba ACC (SBCW) / Asuncion ACC (SGFA) / Defesa Aerea (COMAE)
inFlightCheckIn.tolerance: Contact Curitiba/Asuncion ACC >=10 minutes prior to international FIR boundary (FOZ/GUAIRA).

BRAZIL_BORDER.exemptions: None for international cross-border executive jet operations.
BRAZIL_BORDER.interceptionWarning: Brazilian Air Force (FAB COMAE) Air Defense Policing rules apply along the western border (Paraguay/Bolivia/Colombia/Venezuela); maintain continuous Mode S/C squawk and monitor 121.5 MHz.
